claim_boundary.limitation: This is one model, one seed, six repaired smoke tasks, and a maximum of five deterministic decisions per task. It tests one new action protocol only and cannot estimate general capability or language effects.

projection.next_gate: Stop live reruns. Audit whether planner and memory fields belong in the action transport contract; do not infer missing research messages or coerce arguments without a separately admitted design.
projection.positive_boundary: The callback task alone executed one exact SQLite call, exposed its created=true result to a second completion, and parsed an exact final form.
projection.registered_falsifier: Five completions emitted only the action object and omitted required planner_note and memory_update, so fail-closed execution made no call.
